# Source and generated files

## Current project deliverables

- `docs/index.html`: generated by `scripts/build_site.py`; project entry point.
- `docs/results/figures/cohort.html` and `scales.html`: generated by `scripts/test.py --plots` and `scripts/train.py --plots`. Edit `scripts/views/*.html`, `*.js`, `report.css`, and `scripts/site_support.py`.
- `docs/reanalysis/missing_data.html`: authored analysis. Shared navigation and the eligibility comparison are refreshed by `scripts/build_site.py`.
- `docs/presentation/deck.html` and `Presenter_notes.md`: generated by `scripts/build_presentation.py` from result CSVs. Eight-slide missing-data narrative.
- `docs/poster/main.tex`, `poster_figures.py`: current poster source and data-driven figures. The figure script also generates `case_record43.tex`; edit its patient-table generator rather than the generated table. `RenalLens_Poster.pdf` is the print version and `preview.png` its rendered review image. See `docs/poster/BUILD.md` for current and supplementary figure roles.
- `docs/report/main.tex`, `report_figures.py`: current one-page report source and data-driven figures.
- `docs/clinical_report.src.html`: authored source for the earlier clinical-strata report; `scripts/clinical_figures.py --report docs/clinical_report.html` embeds its figures.

## Companion and archived alternatives

- `docs/reanalysis/index.html`: companion CKD case study.
- `docs/presentation/case-study.html` and `Case_study_notes.md`: preserved original case-study presentation; the main presentation is `deck.html`.
- `docs/poster/poster_template/` and `docs/report/report_template/`: original style templates, retained for provenance. Edit the parent `main.tex` for the current deliverables.
- `docs/DSC5002_CKD_Proposal.pdf`, `docs/proposal.md`: original proposal and background.

## Reproduction

Run these commands from the repository root:

```sh
uv sync --locked
npm ci
npx playwright install chromium
uv run --locked python scripts/build.py --download --check --package
```

Add `--pdf` with Chrome and TeX installed. The rebuild uses the unchanged UCI input, seed 20261115 and 5,000 bootstrap draws. Generated HTML is self-contained for its scripts/data; site navigation uses relative paths, while query strings carry the original patient row number between explorers.

The 24-field baseline tables remain unchanged. `eligibility_rules.csv` adds four explicitly named field sets. The interactive current-field rule uses one measured field for the patient matrix/distribution and both measured fields for each correlation pair.
